name: KV-9
summary: A 95 m patrol frigate built around a 46 m spinal railgun. Faceted armour, eight launch cells, two drives and a crew of twenty-four who share six bunks in two watches.

rooms.name: Bridge
rooms.description: Three seats abreast behind a 1.1 m armoured slit: helm, weapons, sensors. The slit is the only direct view on the ship and closes behind a shutter at action stations, after which the crew fly on repeaters from the compartment below. Everything here is duplicated in the CIC, so a hit on the bridge costs the ship its windows and nothing else.

hotspots.title: Helm Seat
hotspots.text: Centre of three. Gimbal-mounted and rated to 9 g on the burn axis.

hotspots.title: Armoured Slit
hotspots.text: 110 mm of transparent laminate in a shuttered recess.

hotspots.title: Console Rail
hotspots.text: A single rail carries all three stations' displays; any seat can take any role.

rooms.name: Combat Information Centre
rooms.description: Four consoles around a plot table on the ship's centre of armour, one deck below the bridge. The room fuses radar, lidar and passive tracks into a single picture and hands firing solutions to the railgun and the cells. It runs on its own power ring and holds six hours of air, so the ship fights from here after the bridge is shuttered.

hotspots.title: Plot Table
hotspots.text: The fused picture: every track inside 40,000 km with its firing solution.

hotspots.title: Weapons Console
hotspots.text: Assigns targets to the railgun and the eight cells. Two keys to release.

rooms.name: Railgun Battery
rooms.description: A 46 m electromagnetic spine that runs from the breech at frame 2 to the muzzle brake. Six accelerator rings take a 4 kg slug to 7 km/s; the charge comes from a capacitor bank that takes ninety seconds to refill from the reactor. The barrel is the ship's structural keel, so the whole hull is built to take the recoil.

hotspots.title: Accelerator Ring
hotspots.text: One of six. Each adds 1.2 km/s and dumps its heat into the forward loop.

hotspots.title: Muzzle Brake
hotspots.text: Vents the driving field so the plasma flash does not blind the bow sensors.

rooms.name: Magazine
rooms.description: Eight racks of slugs around the breech, behind a blow-out panel that vents outboard if a rack cooks off. Capacity is 240 rounds, which is four hours of sustained fire or a single long engagement. Loading is automatic; the compartment is unmanned while the gun is charged and the hatch interlocks with the capacitor bank.

rooms.name: Missile Cells
rooms.description: Eight vertical cells in two rows on the dorsal plate, each holding one interceptor or one ship-killer. Cells fire cold: a gas charge throws the round clear before the motor lights, so a failed motor falls away instead of burning in the tube. Reloading needs a tender alongside and takes twenty minutes a cell.

hotspots.title: Cell Hatch
hotspots.text: Blows clear on the gas charge; the tube reseals behind the round.

rooms.name: Crew Berths
rooms.description: Six bunks in two tiers for a crew of twenty-four, which works because the ship keeps four watches and nobody is off duty at the same time. Personal stowage is one 0.4 m³ drawer each. The compartment sits inside the belt armour with the mess table folded against the forward bulkhead, and doubles as the damage-control muster point.

hotspots.title: Bunk Tier
hotspots.text: Hot-bunked across four watches. Curtains, no doors.

hotspots.title: Light Strip
hotspots.text: Shifts to red twenty minutes before a watch change.

rooms.name: Sick Bay
rooms.description: One pod, one locker wall and a folding table. It treats one casualty properly and three badly, which matches what a frigate can expect before it breaks contact. The medic is the second engineer. Anything past stabilisation goes to a tender or to the nearest cruiser with a proper bay.

rooms.name: Airlock & EVA Bay
rooms.description: A 2.2 m lock on the port quarter with two suits racked either side of the inner door. It cycles in forty seconds and is the only way out of the ship under way. Hull repair kit and the magnetic crawler stow overhead; the bay is also where boarding parties stage, four at a time.

hotspots.title: Outer Door
hotspots.text: Field membrane behind a mechanical hatch; the hatch is what holds pressure.

hotspots.title: Suit Rack
hotspots.text: Two suits at immediate readiness, pre-breathed at 70 kPa.

rooms.name: Reactor & Drives
rooms.description: A 260 MW fission core and two magnetoplasma drives in one unpressurised block. The core feeds the drives, the capacitor bank and the ship, in that order, and sheds its heat through the two canted wings. Peak acceleration is 0.6 g, which is enough to run down a freighter and not enough to escape a cruiser.

hotspots.title: Core
hotspots.text: Fission, not fusion: cheap, compact and hot for its output.

rooms.name: Radiator Wings
rooms.description: Two 15 m panels canted off the hull at 49°, which keeps them out of the railgun's arc and presents the thinnest edge to anything ahead. They reject 190 MW. Running silent means folding them flat and living on the heat sink, which buys eleven minutes at full power before the ship has to radiate or shut down.

systems.name: Power
systems.description: Reactor forward on a single armoured bus: capacitor bank first, then the cells, then the hull.

systems.name: Coolant
systems.description: Two loops: the gun's own forward loop, and the reactor loop out to the wings.

systems.name: Atmos
systems.description: Only four compartments hold pressure: bridge, CIC, berths and the lock. Everything aft of frame 12 is vacuum.

systems.name: Data
systems.description: Sensors to the CIC, CIC to the weapons. The bridge is a repeater, not a node.

segments.name: Full-Ship Overview
segments.caption: Ninety-five metres of armour wrapped around one gun. Twenty-four crew, four watches, no spin gravity.

segments.name: Engineering
segments.caption: A 260 MW fission core and two drives in an unpressurised block, with the wings canted clear of the gun's arc.

segments.name: Midships
segments.caption: Six bunks, one sick bay and a lock. Everything the crew touches sits inside the belt armour.

segments.name: Railgun
segments.caption: Six accelerator rings take a four-kilogram slug to seven kilometres a second. The barrel is the keel.

segments.name: Bow
segments.caption: Two hundred and forty rounds behind a blow-out panel, loaded automatically and never manned when charged.

segments.name: Bridge
segments.caption: Three seats and an armoured slit, duplicated one deck down in case the shutter has to close.

segments.name: EVA Bay
segments.caption: The only way out under way: a forty-second cycle and two suits at readiness.

segments.name: Drives
segments.caption: Fold the wings and the ship runs silent for eleven minutes, then radiates or shuts down.
